title: fss.acquisition.session_checkpoint.v1
description: Bounded, externally anchored acquisition lifecycle checkpoint. Carries the exact request, retained lifecycle state, sticky gap flag, and bounded audit tail; no device handles or media bytes. The SHA-256 of the encoded bytes must be committed separately to trusted durable custody; restoration requires both the trusted checkpoint digest and the exact request digest, and unknown or damaged input never falls back to a fresh session.

schema.description: Stable schema identity; the checkpoint is refused on any other value.

request.description: The exact AcquisitionRequest (source/device/adapter identities, capabilities, timing) the checkpoint is bound to; restored only against its independent trusted digest.

has_windowed_gap.description: Sticky continuity-gap flag: once set, interval-free absence claims are impossible even after reconciliation.

state.description: The acquisition lifecycle state at checkpoint time, bounded to depth 8; failed/cancelled states remain terminal, authenticated-only sessions must reauthenticate in a new generation, and active states gain an explicit restart-uncertainty receipt.

history.description: Bounded audit tail of lifecycle records in canonical order.
